definitions.explanation: A formal notice or report submitted to authorities or an organization, often required by law or regulations.

examples.japanese: {転居届出|てんきょとどけで}を{市役所|しやくしょ}に{提出|ていしゅつ}した。
examples.english: I submitted a change of address notification to city hall.

examples.japanese: {届出|とどけで}が{必要|ひつよう}な{場合|ばあい}は{早|はや}めに{手続|てつづ}きしてください。
examples.english: If notification is required, please complete the procedure early.

examples.japanese: {届出|とどけで}なしに{営業|えいぎょう}することは{違法|いほう}です。

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{届|とどけ} (notification) + {出|で} (submission)

COMMON TYPES OF {届出|とどけで}:
・{婚姻届出|こんいんとどけで} - marriage registration
・{出生届出|しゅっせいとどけで} - birth registration
・{転居届出|てんきょとどけで} - change of address notification
・{死亡届出|しぼうとどけで} - death registration
・{開業届出|かいぎょうとどけで} - business registration
・{退職届出|たいしょくとどけで} - resignation notice

VARIATION:
・{届|とどけ} - shorter form, used similarly
・{届け出|とどけで} - alternative spelling

COLLOCATIONS:
・{届出|とどけで}をする - to submit a notification
・{届出|とどけで}を{受|う}け{付|つ}ける - to accept a registration
・{届出|とどけで}{書類|しょるい} - notification documents
・{届出|とどけで}{義務|ぎむ} - obligation to report

LEGAL CONTEXT:
Many {届出|とどけで} are legally required in Japan for life events, business activities, and regulatory compliance.
